overviewParagraphs: The Nicklaus Course at BRG Da Nang Golf Resort is a bold departure from traditional Asian layouts, bringing Asia's first authentic bulkhead-style course to Vietnam's Central Coast. Designed by the Jack Nicklaus Design team, the course emphasizes precision and tactical navigation at every turn.

Opened in 2020, the layout features iconic wood-faced bulkheads separating perfectly manicured fairways from strategic water features. Hole 17 — a dramatic par-3 requiring a carry over water to a bulkheaded green — stands as the course's unforgettable signature experience.

Utilizing premium Platinum Paspalum turf throughout, the course ensures a lush, responsive playing surface year-round. As part of the world-class 36-hole BRG Da Nang complex, the Nicklaus Course offers a technically distinct challenge for golfers seeking professional-grade conditioning.

curatorBriefHtml: BRG Da Nang Golf Resort’s Nicklaus Course (opened 2018) is Asia’s first true Florida-style wooden-bulkhead championship layout — a dramatic departure from the sandy dunes of its sister Norman Course right next door. Stretching to 7,380 yards as a rare Par 73 (featuring five par 5s), Jack Nicklaus Design framed nearly every landing zone and green complex with imported timber bulkheads bordering crisp waterways.

Having played the Nicklaus Course personally, what defines scoring here is trajectory control and patience around the water. Fairways are wide and manicured in plush Platinum Paspalum, yet careless approaches toward bulkhead-guarded pins leave zero bailout room. The back nine also features full floodlit night golf, offering an excellent twilight alternative if your group wants a second evening round in Da Nang.

Sitting midway between Da Nang city and Hoi An (just 20 minutes from either base), the Nicklaus Course pairs cleanly with the adjacent Norman Course for a 36-hole day, or as a contrast to links golf at Hoiana Shores.

scorecard.itemName: BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (Nicklaus Course)
scorecard.verdict: Jack Nicklaus's signature bulkhead design delivers an unyielding tactical exam. Water borders multiple approach corridors, demanding precise ball-striking over raw distance. An essential twin-billing alongside the adjacent Norman course.

faqs.q: How is the Nicklaus Course at BRG Da Nang different from the Norman Course?
faqs.a: The Nicklaus Course is a lush, water-laced Par 73 Florida-style bulkhead design with crisp timber-walled lakes and five par 5s, whereas the older Norman Course plays as a rugged, firm coastal dunes layout with native casuarina trees and sprawling waste bunkers.

faqs.q: Does the BRG Da Nang Nicklaus Course have night golf?
faqs.a: Yes. BRG Da Nang’s Nicklaus Course features floodlighting on its back/championship holes, allowing late-afternoon tee times that finish comfortably under lights when coastal daytime heat peaks.

faqs.q: How far is BRG Da Nang Golf Resort from Da Nang Airport and Hoi An?
faqs.a: BRG Da Nang sits right on the coastal boulevard roughly 20 minutes south of Da Nang International Airport (DAD) and 15–20 minutes north of Hoi An and An Bang Beach.

faqs.q: Which of the two BRG Da Nang courses should we play if we only have time for one?
faqs.a: Links purists typically favor the Norman Course for its raw sandy dunes character (especially the iconic ocean-backed 16th), while resort golfers who love immaculate resort parkland and dramatic water carries gravitate to the Nicklaus Course.
